exploit_name: Withdrawing before bad debt event increases losses for remaining LPs
description: Withdrawal mechanics don't protect against timing attacks where users withdraw before realizing losses.
root_cause: Withdrawal mechanics don't protect against timing attacks where users withdraw before realizing losses.
fix_description: Implement withdrawal queues or epoch-based settlements preventing same-block withdrawals.
notes: Bad debt burden shifted to remaining LPs. Extractive withdrawal incentive during stressed periods.
